proposal.root_cause: Commit f92a0343 added a required podAntiAffinity (app=worker, topologyKey kubernetes.io/hostname) to the worker Deployment; on the single-node cluster with existing worker pods on that node, the new pod from ReplicaSet worker-6b549cc7fb can never be scheduled.
proposal.rationale: Pod worker-6b549cc7fb-szh96 is Pending with PodScheduled=False: '0/1 nodes are available: 1 node(s) didn't match pod anti-affinity rules'. The cluster has a single node (repair-control-plane) already running two worker pods (worker-65d89fdfc8-*), so the required podAntiAffinity on app=worker / topologyKey kubernetes.io/hostname makes any new worker pod unschedulable. Git diff of the latest commit touching deploy/demo/worker.yaml (f92a0343c7a937cc79666f43742d40b44cae8e46, 'chore(demo): update worker.yaml') shows this affinity block was added in that commit; removing it restores the last known good spec. Resource requests (25m/32Mi) are small, so two replicas co-located on the single node is fine and replicas:2 need not change.
proposal.verify: After Argo CD syncs the change, ReplicaSet worker-6b549cc7fb's pod worker-6b549cc7fb-szh96 should become Running/Ready (PodScheduled=True), and the worker Deployment should show 2/2 available replicas with no FailedScheduling events.

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: worker
  namespace: demo
  labels:
    app: worker
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
  annotations:
    repair.example.dev/source-path: deploy/demo/worker.yaml
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: worker
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: worker
        app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
    spec:
      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:
          requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
            - labelSelector:
                matchLabels:
                  app: worker
              topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
      containers:
        - name: worker
          image: python:3.12-alpine
          command: ["python", "/app/worker.py"]
          volumeMounts:
            - name: code
              mountPath: /app
              readOnly: true
          resources:
            requests:
              memory: 32Mi
              cpu: 25m
            limits:
              memory: 64Mi
              cpu: 250m
      volumes:
        - name: code
          configMap:
            name: worker-code
